mapper.select: select a.cart_id ,a.cart_price ,a.cart_quantity ,b.name ,b.pd_quantity ,a.user_user_id ,cart_regDate ,b.pd_id ,c.path from cart a left join product b on b.pd_id = a.product_pd_id left join `user` u on a.user_user_id = u.user_id left join productUploaded c on c.pseq = b.pd_id where 1=1 and u.user_id =#{user_user_id}
